hero.title: Found, fixed, tested.
hero.lede: Leaks, boilers and radiators across Bristol, with a fixed price before we pick up a spanner. Scroll and follow one call-out from the phone ringing to the sign-off.

stages.c: Water coming through the kitchen ceiling, right under the bath. We pick up on the second ring.
The nearest engineer is twelve minutes out. You get a text with his name and a live map.
Water off at the stopcock, then traced from the main to the bath. The waste seal has split.
New trap and seal fitted, joints made with fresh copper. Old parts left with you to see.
Water back on, bath filled and drained twice. Not a drop, and the pressure holds.
Price as quoted, photos of the work, and a twelve-month guarantee by email.

fix.title: Tell us the problem. Get the price.
fix.sub: Pick what's happening. You'll see what to do right now, roughly what it costs and how fast we can be there. The engineer confirms the price before starting.

problems.now: Turn the water off at the stopcock (usually under the kitchen sink) and catch what you can.

problems.hint: Boiler off or showing a fault
problems.now: Check the boiler pressure (1 to 1.5 bar) and that the thermostat is calling for heat.
Stop using the water in that room. Don't keep flushing.

problems.hint: Cold at the top or all over
problems.now: Try bleeding it with a radiator key. If it stays cold, the valve may be stuck.
Nothing urgent: put a cloth in the sink so it's quieter tonight.

problems.hint: Once a year, keeps the warranty
problems.now: Nothing to do: we'll check everything and leave you a certificate.

fix.note: Prices include the first hour and standard parts. Anything more, we tell you before we do it.

prices.title: The price first. No surprises.
prices.sub: A fixed call-out, a clear hourly rate, and set prices for the jobs we do every week. Out-of-hours rates are shown, not hidden.

rates.v: at cost, shown on the quote

jobs.d: Like for like, drained and refilled

area.title: Bristol and twenty minutes around it.
area.sub: Type your town or postcode area to see if we cover you and how fast an engineer can get there today.

credentials.d: On all labour and the parts we fit

book.title: Pick a slot. We'll text when we're on the way.
book.sub: Two-hour arrival windows, a text with the engineer's name and a live ETA. No call-out charge if we're late.
